panels.description: Addresses in the subnet that sent or received at least one flow in the time range (the collector's network_flow).

targets.query:
import "array"
import "math"
import "regexp"
import "strings"

// The Subnet box, exactly. A prefix regex on the octet boundary at or above
// the prefix is what InfluxDB pushes down (see the cidr helper elsewhere);
// it reads a superset. Then the exact test runs on the rows left after the
// per-host aggregate -- one row per host, never per flow -- so /20 or /27
// mean what they say here, unlike the cidr boxes that round down.
raw = strings.trimSpace(v: "${subnet}")
given = raw != ""
spec = if given then raw else "255.255.255.255/32"
p = strings.split(v: spec, t: "/")
bits = if length(arr: p) > 1 then int(v: p[1]) else 32
o = strings.split(v: p[0], t: ".")
prefixRe =
    if bits <= 0 then "^[0-9]+\\."
    else if bits <= 8 then "^" + o[0] + "\\."
    else if bits <= 16 then "^" + o[0] + "\\." + o[1] + "\\."
    else if bits < 32 then "^" + o[0] + "\\." + o[1] + "\\." + o[2] + "\\."
    else "^" + o[0] + "\\." + o[1] + "\\." + o[2] + "\\." + o[3] + "$"
cidrRe = regexp.compile(v: prefixRe)
ipInt = (ip) => {
    q = strings.split(v: ip, t: ".")

    return
        if length(arr: q) == 4 then
            int(v: q[0]) * 16777216 + int(v: q[1]) * 65536 + int(v: q[2]) * 256 + int(v: q[3])
        else
            -1
}
size = int(v: math.pow(x: 2.0, y: float(v: 32 - bits)))
netBase = ipInt(ip: p[0]) - ipInt(ip: p[0]) % size
// The network and broadcast addresses of a /30 or wider are not hosts (the
// broadcast one otherwise shows up as a "host" receiving every broadcast).
edges = bits <= 30
inNet = (ip) => {
    i = ipInt(ip: ip)

    return given and i >= 0 and i - i % size == netBase
        and not (edges and (i == netBase or i == netBase + size - 1))
}

sentinel = array.from(rows: [{_value: -1}])

s = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_flow" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.src_ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> sum()
  |> rename(columns: {src_ip: "ip"})
d = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_flow" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dst_ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["dst_ip"])
  |> sum()
  |> rename(columns: {dst_ip: "ip"})
n = union(tables: [s, d])
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => inNet(ip: r.ip))
  |> distinct(column: "ip")
  |> count()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

if given then union(tables: [n, array.from(rows: [{_value: 0}])]) |> sum() else sentinel

panels.title: Hosts Seen in ARP
panels.description: Addresses in the subnet that some MAC answered ARP for in the time range (arp-watch). 0 where the mirror carries no ARP -- a mangle mirror, an  TAP -- which is not the same as no hosts.

options.content:
Type a subnet in the **Subnet** box (`10.12.6.0/24`, `192.168.73.0/26`, or a bare IP). Any prefix length is exact here.

Click an **IP** for its drill-down, a **MAC** for its ARP history. Hostnames are reverse DNS; vendors come from the IEEE registry.

panels.title: Hosts in $subnet
panels.description: Every address in the subnet seen in the time range: in a flow record (either end), or answering ARP. Traffic is the collector's, and nfstream counts both directions of a flow together, so Sent = bytes of the flows the host opened, Received = bytes of the flows it answered, Total = both. MAC/Vendor are the newest ARP answer for the address (several MACs: all of them, newest first, and the vendor of the newest; the Ethernet Attacks board says whether that is a new lease or an impersonation). A host only seen in ARP has no traffic in range. At most the Hosts box's number of the busiest hosts are listed (and as many ARP-only ones). Hostname is reverse DNS from this instance's resolver, and blank for another site.

targets.query:
import "array"
import "math"
import "regexp"
import "strings"

// The Subnet box, exactly. A prefix regex on the octet boundary at or above
// the prefix is what InfluxDB pushes down (see the cidr helper elsewhere);
// it reads a superset. Then the exact test runs on the rows left after the
// per-host aggregate -- one row per host, never per flow -- so /20 or /27
// mean what they say here, unlike the cidr boxes that round down.

spec = if given then raw else "255.255.255.255/32"
p = strings.split(v: spec, t: "/")

o = strings.split(v: p[0], t: ".")

    if bits <= 0 then "^[0-9]+\\."
    else if bits <= 8 then "^" + o[0] + "\\."
    else if bits <= 16 then "^" + o[0] + "\\." + o[1] + "\\."
    else if bits < 32 then "^" + o[0] + "\\." + o[1] + "\\." + o[2] + "\\."
    else "^" + o[0] + "\\." + o[1] + "\\." + o[2] + "\\." + o[3] + "$"
cidrRe = regexp.compile(v: prefixRe)
ipInt = (ip) => {
    q = strings.split(v: ip, t: ".")

    return
        if length(arr: q) == 4 then
            int(v: q[0]) * 16777216 + int(v: q[1]) * 65536 + int(v: q[2]) * 256 + int(v: q[3])
        else
            -1
}
size = int(v: math.pow(x: 2.0, y: float(v: 32 - bits)))
netBase = ipInt(ip: p[0]) - ipInt(ip: p[0]) % size
// The network and broadcast addresses of a /30 or wider are not hosts (the
// broadcast one otherwise shows up as a "host" receiving every broadcast).
edges = bits <= 30
inNet = (ip) => {
    i = ipInt(ip: ip)

    return given and i >= 0 and i - i % size == netBase
        and not (edges and (i == netBase or i == netBase + size - 1))
}

// Six pushed-down aggregates, each one row per host: bytes, flows and the
// last flow, for the host as initiator (src) and as responder (dst).
sentB = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_flow" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.src_ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> sum()
  |> toFloat()
  |> rename(columns: {src_ip: "ip"})
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "sent")
  |> keep(columns: ["ip", "_field", "_value"])
recvB = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_flow" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dst_ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["dst_ip"])
  |> sum()
  |> toFloat()
  |> rename(columns: {dst_ip: "ip"})
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "received")
  |> keep(columns: ["ip", "_field", "_value"])
flowsS = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_flow" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.src_ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> count()
  |> toFloat()
  |> rename(columns: {src_ip: "ip"})
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "flows")
  |> keep(columns: ["ip", "_field", "_value"])
flowsR = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_flow" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dst_ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["dst_ip"])
  |> count()
  |> toFloat()
  |> rename(columns: {dst_ip: "ip"})
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "flows")
  |> keep(columns: ["ip", "_field", "_value"])
lastS = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_flow" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.src_ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: int(v: r._time) / 1000000)}))
  |> toFloat()
  |> rename(columns: {src_ip: "ip"})
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "last")
  |> keep(columns: ["ip", "_field", "_value"])
lastR = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_flow" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dst_ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["dst_ip"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: int(v: r._time) / 1000000)}))
  |> toFloat()
  |> rename(columns: {dst_ip: "ip"})
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "last")
  |> keep(columns: ["ip", "_field", "_value"])

sums = union(tables: [sentB, recvB, flowsS, flowsR])
  |> group(columns: ["ip", "_field"])
  |> sum()
lasts = union(tables: [lastS, lastR])
  |> group(columns: ["ip", "_field"])
  |> max()

union(tables: [sums, lasts])
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => inNet(ip: r.ip))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["ip"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
      sent: if exists r.sent then r.sent else 0.0,
      received: if exists r.received then r.received else 0.0}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with total: r.sent + r.received}))
  |> sort(columns: ["total"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: ${max_hosts})
  |> keep(columns: ["ip", "sent", "received", "total", "flows", "last"])

o = strings.split(v: p[0], t: ".")
prefixRe =
    if bits <= 0 then "^[0-9]+\\."
    else if bits <= 8 then "^" + o[0] + "\\."
    else if bits <= 16 then "^" + o[0] + "\\." + o[1] + "\\."
    else if bits < 32 then "^" + o[0] + "\\." + o[1] + "\\." + o[2] + "\\."
    else "^" + o[0] + "\\." + o[1] + "\\." + o[2] + "\\." + o[3] + "$"
cidrRe = regexp.compile(v: prefixRe)
ipInt = (ip) => {
    q = strings.split(v: ip, t: ".")

    return
        if length(arr: q) == 4 then
            int(v: q[0]) * 16777216 + int(v: q[1]) * 65536 + int(v: q[2]) * 256 + int(v: q[3])
        else
            -1
}
size = int(v: math.pow(x: 2.0, y: float(v: 32 - bits)))
netBase = ipInt(ip: p[0]) - ipInt(ip: p[0]) % size
// The network and broadcast addresses of a /30 or wider are not hosts (the
// broadcast one otherwise shows up as a "host" receiving every broadcast).
edges = bits <= 30
inNet = (ip) => {
    i = ipInt(ip: ip)

    return given and i >= 0 and i - i % size == netBase
        and not (edges and (i == netBase or i == netBase + size - 1))
}

s = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_flow" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.src_ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> sum()
  |> rename(columns: {src_ip: "ip"})
d = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_flow" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dst_ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["dst_ip"])
  |> sum()
  |> rename(columns: {dst_ip: "ip"})
traffic = union(tables: [s, d])
  |> group(columns: ["ip"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => inNet(ip: r.ip))
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: ${max_hosts})
  |> keep(columns: ["ip"])
arp = from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "arp_binding" and r._field == "packets")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ip =~ cidrRe)
  |> group(columns: ["ip"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => inNet(ip: r.ip))
  |> limit(n: ${max_hosts})
  |> keep(columns: ["ip"])

union(tables: [traffic, arp])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "ip")

title: Subnet Hosts
description: Every host in one subnet: its traffic, reverse-DNS name, and the MAC and NIC vendor that answer ARP for it.
